plaatsen.tekst: When the waves of death compassed me, the floods of ungodly men made me afraid;
Deep calleth unto deep at the noise of thy waterspouts: all thy waves and thy billows are gone
Thy wrath lieth hard upon me, and thou hast afflicted me with all thy waves. Selah.
The LORD on high is mightier than the noise of many waters, yea, than the mighty waves of the sea.
For thou hadst cast me into the deep, in the midst of the seas; and the floods compassed me about: all thy billows and thy waves passed over
